name: – Siegfried Mureşan, Carla Tavares – § 12 – Am 10
title: INTERIM REPORT on the proposal for a Council regulation laying down the Multiannual Financial Framework for the years 2028 to 2034
part_text: 12. Underlines that compliance with Union values and the rule of law is an essential prerequisite for access to EU funds; insists on the importance of a seamless and coherent EU values toolbox covering democracy, the rule of law and fundamental rights across the entire EU budget; insists on a robust approach to ensure that legitimate final recipients are not penalised for rule of law breaches by their governments; insists that access to EU funds be subject to strong social conditionality, including full respect for trade union rights, collective bargaining, equal pay, decent wages, occupational health and safety standards, and secure employment; calls for entities infringing labour or social rights to be excluded from accessing EU funds;
